title: Momoi Airi — A Song Of Courage〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Wow... That's amazing...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “You two are completely different in terms of styles, but both your performances were so powerful. I was really moved by them...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I didn't realize music could be so free and fun...!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Then, why don't we sing together?”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “I'd like to sing that song I taught you the other day.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Okay...!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is awesome! You looked like you were having so much fun that I almost started singing with you♪

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Yeah! You did a really good job of singing while staying in character, like Kusanagi said!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What did you think, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you've both improved quite a lot. I could really sense what your characters were feeling!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That means all our hard work is starting to pay off!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Alright, can we go through that part one more time while the feeling's still fresh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As much as I'd like to, I'm pretty sure we have...
Hey, can someone let me in?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, right on cue!
Be right there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks for getting the door for me!
All our hands are completely full right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, those look pretty heavy.
Why don't you all set everything down over there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi.
We can set our things down here, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Costume Designer
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Costume Designer
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! Airi's really here...!

rows.Speaker: Costume Designer
rows.Line: Yeah! Getting to design costumes with Shizuku has been amazing, but to think that Airi's gonna wear what we make!

rows.Speaker: Costume Designer
rows.Line: We get to talk about this for the rest of our lives!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They really love you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right? I'm an idol, after all, and a good one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Truth is, I'm also really looking forward to seeing you in the costumes we made♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, what's the holdup? Show us what you got already.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Slow down! Since we're all here, we wanna take this chance to make some fit adjustments and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Costume Designer
rows.Line: Mind if we get started, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, go right ahead.

rows.Speaker: Costume Designer
rows.Line: Then, we'll call you up using your character names. Please come over here when we do.

rows.Speaker: Costume Designer
rows.Line: Starting with the Butler and house staff, and the tutor!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? That's me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As the director, I should probably sit in.
se_walk_men_005_1
se_walk_men_005_2

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's just a few of us at a time...
We might be waiting around for a while.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I wish we could use this time more productively...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know! While we wait, why don't we have them show us the key points of our costumes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think it's important to know the specific characteristics of our costumes and what feelings they put into them, to make sure we can shine on stage together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, on second thought, the idol in me might be focusing too much on the little details.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, I agree with you!
That stuff is really important in our shows, too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, I agree as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So... I'm sure your mental images of your characters have developed as you've been practicing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Putting on a costume can make those mental images more vivid, but knowing how it was made can help make them more concrete and specific.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In other words...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's okay for us to tell you guys all about our design processes?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. A lot of you seem like you can'twait to, so by all means!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yes! Alright, let's get all the costumes out♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mizuki! Mizuki! Show me the one I'm gonna wear!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure thing♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, why don't I tell you about all the work I put into the embroidery?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'd really like to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line:
M-Me too...!
Me too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, within reason, let's ask the costume designers all about their creations while we wait!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Okay!
Okay♪
